meta.title: Ballade (Op. 100, No. 15 - Opening Dramatic Theme)
meta.composer_source: Study after Friedrich Burgmuller, Op. 100 No. 15

theory.summary: Stormy C-minor 6/8 narrative etude combining a driving compound bass pulse with dramatic melodic leaps.
theory.pattern_tip: Feel 6/8 in two urgent dotted-quarter beats per bar; watch for B-natural leading tones and Ab -> G half-steps.
theory.technique_tip: Keep the repeated left-hand 8th-note chords close to the keys with a firm rhythmic pulse.
theory.ballade_link: Directly anticipates Romantic ballad storytelling and 6/8 dramatic minor-key agitation.
